opening.argument: The presentation describes employment and tutoring opportunities through compensation, role requirements, and ordinary application steps. It introduces smartphone-based work paid by the hour or per call, then describes a computer-based application before work can be done on a mobile device. The tutoring opportunity likewise pairs an app download with a stated hourly rate and a teaching-certificate requirement. Those prompts are presented as steps toward participating in the described work. A separate ebook promotion appears, but the supplied material does not show its destination or payment conditions. Nor does it establish an upfront payment demand, credential theft, deceptive identity, victim loss, or a completed transaction.
